title: TreeAI D1 evidence event (one JSONL line of a raw event stream)
description: One line of a d1-spikes/evidence/<impl>/<scenario>.events.jsonl file. Producers: Agent B (sdk-node) and Agent C (rpc-python). All required fields come from the TreeAI D1 task book section 6.1. seq must start at 1 and be strictly increasing within one file; that cross-line rule is enforced by scripts/verify-d1 because JSON Schema cannot express it. payload must already be redacted before it is written: no credentials, no Authorization headers, no absolute user-home paths; set redactionVersion to the redaction rules that were applied. Revision 2026-09-20: tree-navigation is the canonical supplementary scenario; tree-nav remains an accepted compatibility alias for existing SDK evidence.

seq.description: 1-based sequence number, strictly increasing within one events file.

observedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the event was observed (UTC recommended).

implementation.description: Which probe produced this event. Must match the evidence directory (sdk or rpc).

scenario.description: Which D1 scenario this event belongs to. tree-navigation is the canonical supplementary tree navigation scenario; tree-nav is a compatibility alias for existing SDK evidence. Must match the file name.

sessionId.description: Redacted or test-only session identifier. Must not contain credentials or absolute user-home paths.

piEventType.description: Pi-native event type name, kept verbatim (for example message_update). Do not translate or normalize away original fields.

runState.description: Pi-native run or session state at observation time (for example running).

payload.description: Redacted event payload. Preserve the original structure; do not turn guesses into facts.

redactionVersion.description: Version tag of the redaction rules that were applied (d1-v1 = rules in scripts/check-secrets and schemas/README.md).

error.description: Structured error attached to the last known event when a scenario fails. Required by the task book: a failing scenario must still record its last known event and a structured error.
